Modern Conscious Parenting

Research shows that a parent's ability to manage their own emotions is one of the strongest predictors of their child's future success.

Traditional vs. Positive Discipline
Traditional
Focuses on stopping the behavior
Uses fear or shame as a motivator
Parent is the 'Boss'
Positive
Focuses on teaching the skill
Uses connection as a motivator
Parent is the 'Guide'
